capabilities: Create, move, and resize time blocks on day and week timelines
Save schedules as Markdown in daily notes
Break goals into steps and schedule steps as time blocks
Track goal progress from completed block hours
Sync data between devices through an optional private GitHub Gist
extras: Optional GitHub Gist sync is off by default; the token is stored in plaintext in the plugin's data.json. No network calls are made unless sync is enabled.
problem: Obsidian lacks a visual way to plan a day in time blocks and connect scheduled work to goal progress.

relations.evidence: 内置可选的 GitHub Gist 云同步

summary: Time-blocking and goal-tracking plugin with day/week timelines, Markdown daily notes, step breakdowns, and optional GitHub Gist sync.
